Global ID and CVIDs

One professional identity. Resumes for every direction.

One person has one Global ID. That GID connects to multiple CVIDs, and each CVID is a different resume with its own link and its own job matches.

Global ID · your account GID-12345-67890 Your persistent identity and public hub: headline, current role and a chosen primary resume.
Global ID

Account-level. One per person, and it stays with you.

CVID

A permanent shareable link for one specific resume.

Job matches

Found for each CVID, not one feed for the whole account.

FAQs

Questions, answered.

Draft answers. Anything that depends on privacy, pricing or policy is marked pending until it is approved.

What is CV-MAKER?
CV-MAKER helps you create and manage resumes, share a resume through a live link, maintain a professional identity, and access career tools.
What is a Global ID (GID)?
Your GID is your persistent professional identity on CV-MAKER. It acts as a hub for the individual resumes linked to your account.
What is a CVID?
A CVID is a shareable link for one specific resume.
Does my Live CV update when I edit it?
Visibility conditions to confirm
The live-resume workflow updates the existing CVID when its resume is edited and saved.
Can I download a PDF?
Yes. The resume preview offers a PDF download.
Who can see my live resume?
Pending approval
[Confirm public visibility, privacy controls and access rules]
Can I create multiple resumes?
Plan limits pending
Yes. A GID can connect to multiple CVIDs.
What does Job Tailoring do?
It uses a job description to generate a tailored resume version and a matching cover letter.
How much does CV-MAKER cost?
Pending approval
[Insert approved plan prices and billing periods]
What is the difference between a GID and a CVID?
The GID represents your overall professional identity; each CVID represents an individual resume, such as one tailored for a particular role.
Can I upload an existing resume?
Yes. Upload a Word or PDF resume and it is read into the builder. Review the extracted information for accuracy.
How does Job Discovery work?
Job Discovery matches job listings to a specific resume and shows match strength and an explanation of the match, where available.
What do Career Roadmap and Interview Prep provide?
Career Roadmap creates a path from a current field toward an optional target field. Interview Prep provides role-specific study material and practice questions and answers.
